intent: Upcoming and past charges on a subscription, in order, with the status as a word. A next-charge summary (amount, date, card, Change card) and a banner with Update card when a payment failed. Composes kit Table, Badge, Button and Empty.
useWhen: show a subscription's upcoming and past charges in billing settings
show only the next charge in a summary
flag a failed payment and ask for a new card
doNotUseWhen: one invoice with line items — InvoiceDocument
a general data table with sorting — DataTable

items.note: { id, date, label, amount, status: 'upcoming'|'invoiced'|'paid'|'failed'|'waived', note? }[]; date and amount pre-formatted.

onUpdateCard.note: Failed-payment banner action, the one solid primary.

requirements: the charges are a kit Table named by the title
status is a word in a kit Badge, not colour alone; the next charge says "Next charge"
aria-busy while loading; the error is role=alert

doNot: Do not invent a local ChargesTable or PaymentHistory
Do not show real card or customer data in examples
Do not mark failed by colour alone
snippet: <BillingSchedule label="Pro plan · example data" items={charges} nextId="dec" onDownloadAll={download} onUpdateCard={updateCard} retryOn="04 Oct" />
